<Heading

  children={"Cancel Backup Run"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/backup/v1alpha1/projects/{projectId}/jobs/{name}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops an unfinished backup run where the storage driver can stop, ending it failed with the message "Backup cancelled.". Works for a run not started yet, a Postgres backup still waiting to start, a VM instance or disk run (its data transfers are cancelled) and a MariaDB run. Refused with FailedPrecondition for a Postgres backup already running, a VM run that has not started moving data yet (retry in a few seconds), and a finished run. Deleting a run is not offered: the driver would carry on and leave an archive nothing refers to.
